title: Arthur Suydam
description: Young Jedi Luke Skywalker finds himself in the primordial swampworld of Dagobah. "l've spent a lot of time in the South, in Florida, exploring swamps, catching snakes...even catching alligators with a rope!" recalls Arthur Suydam, whose art frequently reflects a fascination for things reptilian. Suydam began his comics career back in 1973, illustrating horror scripts for DC's HOUSE OF SECRETS. work for HEAVY METAL and EPIC ILLUSTRATED followed. Suydam's creations include MUGWOG and the popular CHOLLY AND FLYTRAP, which is set in an environment that is either a post-holocaust Earth or another planet entirely. Though currently concentrating on book jackets and movie posters, he is also developing an original 48-page graphic novel.
